hotels.name: Seaside Paradise Resort
hotels.location: Beachfront, 5 min walk to town center
hotels.notes: Includes breakfast buffet and pool access. Free cancellation until 3 days before.

hotels.name: Mountain View Lodge
hotels.notes: Quiet area, great views. No breakfast but kitchen available.

hotels.name: Downtown Boutique Hotel
hotels.location: City center, walking distance to everything
hotels.notes: Stylish rooms, rooftop bar. Can be noisy at night.

activities.name: Snorkeling Tour
activities.notes: Morning slot recommended for calmer waters. Book 2 days ahead.

activities.name: Old Town Walking Tour
activities.notes: Runs daily at 10am and 4pm. Covers history and architecture.

activities.name: Sunset Sailing Cruise
activities.notes: Includes drinks and snacks. Departs 5:30pm. Limited spots.

restaurants.name: La Trattoria
restaurants.notes: Homemade pasta is excellent. Reservations required on weekends.

restaurants.name: The Fish Market
restaurants.notes: Freshest catch in town. Try the grilled octopus. Outdoor seating available.

restaurants.name: Sunrise Cafe
restaurants.notes: Great for breakfast. Avocado toast and fresh juices. Opens at 7am.
